title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Ten named, photo-documentable destinations on Montclair-area corridors in the practical off-campus orbit of Montclair State University.

cards.title: Walk the reservation edge
cards.subtitle: Normal Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Start from the Normal Avenue side and use the county’s trail information to choose a walking route; Quarry Point is the documented scenic lookout.
cards.short_summary: A 157-acre county reservation with walking trails and a scenic overlook.
cards.evidence_claim: Essex County identifies Mills Reservation at Normal Avenue and Reservoir Drive and documents walking/jogging trails plus a cliff overlook toward the New York skyline.
cards.access_notes: The county lists the location as Normal Avenue and Reservoir Drive, Cedar Grove; trail conditions and access can vary.

cards.title: See the iris collection
cards.subtitle: Upper Mountain Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Plan around the garden’s listed 2026 hours and seasonal bloom cycle; the county says the main bloom is typically mid-May into early June.
cards.short_summary: A formal public garden with thousands of iris varieties on Upper Mountain Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: Essex County documents more than 14,000 irises of about 3,000 varieties at Presby Memorial Iris Gardens, 474 Upper Mountain Avenue.
cards.source_title: Presby Memorial Iris Gardens | Essex County Parks
cards.access_notes: Listed 2026 garden hours are daily, 10 a.m.–6 p.m.; confirm seasonal conditions before traveling.

cards.title: Use the paved pathways
cards.subtitle: Bellevue Avenue and North Mountain Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Enter from the Bellevue/North Mountain edge and follow the paved paths for a low-key walk; the county also lists the meadow for informal recreation.
cards.short_summary: An Upper Montclair county park with paved paths and an open meadow.
cards.evidence_claim: Essex County describes Anderson Park as a 14.85-acre park bordered by Bellevue and North Mountain avenues, with paved pathways and meadow space.
cards.access_notes: The county identifies the park boundary at Bellevue Avenue and North Mountain Avenue; use marked public entrances.

cards.title: Take a garden loop
cards.subtitle: Van Vleck Street corridor
cards.notes: Enter through the public gate and wander the six-acre garden grounds; keep amplified sound off and follow the foundation’s neighborhood-use guidance.
cards.short_summary: Admission-free public gardens on a residential Montclair street.
cards.evidence_claim: The Montclair Foundation states that Van Vleck House & Gardens at 21 Van Vleck Street has admission-free gardens open to the public daily from dawn to dusk.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit | The Montclair Foundation
cards.access_notes: Gardens are open dawn to dusk, 365 days a year; the house is not open for public tours.

cards.title: Schedule a gallery visit
cards.subtitle: South Mountain Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Check the current exhibition list, then book or purchase gallery entry before arriving; personal non-flash photography is permitted under the museum’s guidelines.
cards.short_summary: An art museum with changing exhibitions and studio-art programming.
cards.evidence_claim: Montclair Art Museum lists its address as 3 South Mountain Avenue and documents gallery hours, exhibitions, and admission prices.
cards.source_title: Hours and Admission | Montclair Art Museum
cards.access_notes: Gallery hours listed: Friday–Saturday 10 a.m.–6 p.m. and Sunday 11 a.m.–5 p.m.; tickets are available online or at reception.

cards.title: Set up a library stop
cards.subtitle: South Fullerton Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Use the Main Library’s posted desk hours for reading, research, or a librarian appointment; check the library calendar for any program-specific requirements.
cards.short_summary: Montclair’s main public-library location, with evening hours on weekdays.
cards.evidence_claim: Montclair Public Library lists its Main Library at 50 South Fullerton Avenue and posts Monday–Thursday hours through 8 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Posted Main Library hours: Mon–Thu 10 a.m.–8 p.m., Fri–Sat 10 a.m.–6 p.m., Sun 1–6 p.m.; verify holiday closures.

cards.title: Choose a film screening
cards.subtitle: Bloomfield Avenue corridor
cards.notes: Review the current program and rating before buying; the cinema’s box office opens shortly before the first screening and closes after the last.
cards.short_summary: A six-screen nonprofit cinema for first-run, independent, documentary, classic, and foreign-language films.
cards.evidence_claim: Montclair Film identifies The Clairidge at 486 Bloomfield Avenue as a six-screen cinema with year-round film screenings and special events.
cards.access_notes: The box office opens 15 minutes before the first daily screening and closes 15 minutes after the last; select films have accessibility services.

cards.title: Check the event calendar
cards.subtitle: Seymour Street corridor
cards.notes: Look up an all-ages-appropriate event before going, then use the theater’s directions from Bay Street or Walnut Street station to reach Seymour Street.
cards.short_summary: A Montclair performance venue one block off Bloomfield Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: The Wellmont Theater lists its address as 5 Seymour Street and provides walking directions from the nearby Bay Street and Walnut Street rail stations.
cards.access_notes: Box office hours are listed as Monday–Friday noon–5 p.m., plus two hours before showtime on event days; event restrictions vary.

cards.title: Explore local-history resources
cards.subtitle: Orange Road corridor
cards.notes: Use the visit page to distinguish museum tours from the research library, and make an appointment before relying on the archives for a research stop.
cards.short_summary: A local-history organization with historic-house tours, gardens, and an archives library.
cards.evidence_claim: Montclair History Center lists its office and library at 108 Orange Road and its Crane House & Historic YWCA museum at 110 Orange Road.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit | Montclair History Center
cards.access_notes: The office and library are listed Tuesday–Friday, 9 a.m.–3 p.m.; public museum tours occur on scheduled dates and gardens are open daily 8 a.m.–dusk.

cards.title: Browse the market stalls
cards.subtitle: Walnut Street corridor
cards.notes: Arrive within the posted Saturday market window and bring a reusable bag if shopping; vendors and seasonal offerings change, so consult the current lineup.
cards.short_summary: A Saturday market at the Walnut Street Train Station parking lot.
cards.evidence_claim: Montclair Farmers’ Market states that it operates every Saturday at 86 Walnut Street, with seasonal hours and local farmers and food artisans.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours are Saturdays 8 a.m.–1 p.m. June–November and 9 a.m.–1 p.m. December–May; it operates rain or shine unless cancelled.
